title: Encyclopedia-like discharge plea but no merit: Mumbai Court refuses to close Antilia case against Sachin Waze
description: A special National Investigation Agency (NIA) court in Mumbai has refused to close the case against former police officer Sachin Hindurao Waze in the Antilia bomb scare and Mansukh Hiren murder case [Sachin Waze v. State of Maharashtra & Ors.]In an order passed on July 15, special judge Chakor Shrikrishna Baviskar said that the 157‑page plea by Waze seeking discharge in the matter contained “everything under the sun” except merit.He described Waze’s plea as “an apt but unwanted example” of p
